title: Daemonic work extraction from a quantum battery monitored via residual ZZ coupling: data and code
description:
Measurement records, calibration, analysis code and figure scripts accompanying the article Daemonic work extraction from a quantum battery monitored via residual ZZ coupling.

The residual ZZ coupling of a superconducting processor (IBM Quantum Phoenix) is used to monitor a transmon quantum battery through four neighbouring spectator transmons. A real-time controller selects the extraction pulse from the most recent spectator outcomes. The archive contains the compiled circuits and individual shot records of the matched fixed-versus-conditional extraction experiment (9 cycle numbers, 32 charging-phase sequences, 3 circuit types, 331,776 shots), the frozen calibration, the single-cycle experiment, the processed data of every figure and table, and the code that regenerates all reported results.

Code: MIT License. Data and figures: CC BY 4.0.
